feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 2 October 2026 8:44am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 02 October 2026 at 8:45am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure near Iceland will bring fronts through the day.


##Wind##

South or Southwest 4 or 5, increasing 5 or 6 later this morning, then 7 at times later in afternoon and early evening. Veering West or Northwest 4 or 5 later in evening or at first tonight, further decreasing West 3 or 4 late in the night.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, becoming moderate or rough for a time during the late afternoon and evening, then falling slight overnight. Locally slight throughout in Liverpool Bay.


##Weather##

Showers, then persistent rain later today, heavy at times before clearing later in evening or at first tonight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in showers or rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West 3 or 4, gradually backing South or Southwest tomorrow, increasing 4 or 5 overnight into Sunday.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
